title: DTM condo billing-BBL to base-lot resolver (module only): deterministic typed resolver from the verified DB-002 research, no consumer wiring
objective: Build the deterministic condo->base-lot resolver module per the verified research docs/research/condo-base-lot-resolution-sources.md: classify the lot number (7501-7599 billing / 1001-6999 unit / else not-a-condo); billing lot resolves to the SET of base BBLs via DOF DTM Condominiums p8u6-a6it; unit lot resolves via DTM Condominium Units eguu-7ie3; condo_key fallback for the 28 null-billing condos; honest condo_base_lot_unresolved when nothing resolves - never a fabricated base lot; every result carries provenance (dataset id, rowsUpdatedAt, retrieval time, condo_number). The module returns the full base-lot set and NEVER collapses it to one lot or one zoning determination (divergent-zoning handling is a qualified-human legal surface, downstream and out of scope). MODULE ONLY: no property-lookup or ZTLDB pipeline wiring, no route change - wiring is its own later packet
business_reason: DB-002 / D-073-R008 next live-case priority: condo billing BBLs honestly return no data today (298 Wallabout, regression case 2); the verified DTM path converts that into a real zoning lookup once wired

Run `python tools/code_graph/query.py --no-regen impact <path>` before any broad sweep; graph is ADVISORY - verify in source.

SOLE SOURCE (binding): the verified research record docs/research/condo-base-lot-resolution-sources.md (DB-002 dispatch, retrieved 2026-09-18, raw official responses embedded). Implement ITS verified path exactly: PRIMARY = DOF DTM Condominiums Socrata p8u6-a6it (condo_billing_bbl -> one row per condo_base_bbl; text-typed 10-digit BBLs); REVERSE = DTM Condominium Units eguu-7ie3 (unit_bbl -> condo_base_bbl); FALLBACK = condo_key query for the 28 null-billing condos. Do NOT implement the ArcGIS failover in this packet (recorded as a later hardening option). NEVER use PLUTO appbbl as a base-lot source (proven single-valued/incomplete - research section 6.1); it may appear ONLY as an optional cross-check flag. No network in tests: fixtures come from the research record's embedded raw responses, byte-faithful. Validate every BBL against ^\d{10}$ and fail closed on any other shape.

CONTRACT (binding): deterministic, typed, stdlib+existing-deps only. Input: a 10-digit BBL string. Classify by lot number (chars 6-10): 7501-7599 billing lot; 1001-6999 condo unit lot; anything else = NOT_A_CONDO (typed result, no lookup). Output: a typed result carrying the FULL SET of base BBLs (never assume one - the worked case 3022647515 resolves to TWO lots), the resolution path taken (billing/unit/condo_key), and provenance (dataset id, rowsUpdatedAt if available, retrieval timestamp, condo_number/condo_key). Empty/no-match or exhausted fallbacks = a typed honest CONDO_BASE_LOT_UNRESOLVED result - never a fabricated lot, never an exception for a well-formed input. The module makes NO zoning determination and NEVER collapses a multi-lot set; divergent-zoning handling is a downstream qualified-human legal surface (research section 7 step 6) - state that in the module docstring.

TESTS (binding): implement the research record's contract-test pack C1-C14 rows that apply to this module (C1-C7, C9 as an appbbl-independence assertion, C10 schema-shape guard against the stored fixture; C8/C11-C14 are wiring/live-era rows - record them as deferred in the report, do not fake them). Offline fixtures only; determinism (same input twice = same output); the placeholder test file already carries one passing test - keep the suite passing at every checkpoint.

Discovery routing (D-069): out-of-scope findings go in your report; never fix them in-packet. No WebFetch proposals (network default-deny; the connector's live behavior proves in a later wiring/verification packet). Run ruff from services/api cwd before every checkpoint. Thin client: no bulk downloads, no new dependencies (G5/dependency policy - the existing HTTP client stack only).
